subject.title: Feature Request: TUI Notification When Agent Completes (Sound/Desktop Alert)

question: Should OpenClaw core add a default-off TUI completion notification contract now, and which notification modes, platforms, and config shape should it support?
rationale: The request adds user-facing TUI behavior, OS/terminal notification semantics, and new config keys rather than fixing a broken existing contract, so automation should not choose the product boundary.

options.title: Design narrow TUI notifier
options.body: Keep this issue open and specify a default-off contract for terminal bell and any supported desktop/sound backend before implementation.

options.title: Fold into activity watchdog
options.body: Treat TUI completion alerts as a downstream consumer of broader session activity/watchdog work and defer the local TUI-specific config until that contract exists.

options.title: Decline core alerts
options.body: Leave completion alerts to external terminal tooling or future plugins and document the existing status-line, node-notify, and browser-push alternatives instead.

recommendation.title: Design narrow TUI notifier
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and specify a default-off contract for terminal bell and any supported desktop/sound backend before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest history signal on TUI architecture and the likely product boundary for a core TUI config surface.
